Body.Content:
Bullseye routing now supports dynamic user groups and skill relaxation. Administrators can define dynamic groups using representatives’ skills and proficiency levels, and use them at different expansion levels. If work remains unassigned, required skills can be progressively relaxed to broaden the eligible representative pool and improve assignment opportunities—without manually maintaining group membership.

GA date: January CY2027
